name: The Knight and the Lady
summary: A keeper in Ironforge asks you to bring magical works that may benefit the Library. Your efforts help its collection grow.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: A keeper in the Library of Ironforge seeks magical works for its collection. You can bring works that may benefit the library, and the keeper welcomes further additions as its knowledge grows.

faq.answer: The keeper asks you to bring magical works that might benefit the Library's collection.
The collection is in the Library of Ironforge.
The keeper says your efforts expand the library's knowledge.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Knight and the Lady
